recentItems.title: 9/11 survivors, responders and families of victims reflect on 25 years since attacks
recentItems.description:
Friday marks 25 years since the Sept. 11, 2001, terrorist attacks that killed nearly 3,000 people. Survivors, responders and families of the victims spoke with CBS News about their memories of that day and its impact on their lives a quarter-century later.

7:58 Stephen Siller Jr., son of NYC firefighter who died on 9/11
12:12 John Feal, first responder
16:51 Julie Lewis, widow of banker killed in attacks
19:01 Caroline Lewis, Julie's daughter
21:14 Kathe Conlon, first responder
25:43 Elizabeth Miller and Jessica Trant, whose fathers died on 9/11
37:01 Bryan Stern, soldier who helped people escape WTC
43:02 Vanessa Minter, reservations agent who answered flight attendant's call from hijacked plane
45:23 Harry Ong, brother of flight attendant who died on hijacked plane
48:48 Joseph Pfeifer, first FDNY chief to enter WTC and whose brother died during rescue mission

1:09:03 Tillie Geidel Conklin, daughter of NYC firefighter who died on 9/11
